ablation.notes: Phase 4H.2f: Asymmetric HF weights (w_lh=0.5, w_hl=1.5). HL=vertical edges (high-pass rows, low-pass cols). Hypothesis: vertical strokes/gravity may dominate some styles, so emphasizing HL may improve clip. Tests directional style transfer (complement of 4H.2e). Current 0.3:1.0:1.0 → 0.3:0.5:1.5.
